sources.title: The Complete Guide to Prompt Engineering [2026 Edition]
sources.snippet: In 2026, it's widely accepted that 80% of an AI's output quality is determined by the prompt. This guide covers the fundamentals through advanced techniques of prompt engineering — the art and science of crafting instructions that extract the best possible results from LLMs like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude.

sources.title: Prompt engineering - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Prompt engineering is the process of structuring natural language inputs (known as prompts) to produce specified outputs from a generative AI model. sources.title: Prompt Engineering Techniques | IBM
sources.snippet: Prompt engineering techniques are strategies used to design and structure prompts, input queries or instructions, provided to AI models, particularly large language models (LLMs).
